SAP PIPO defaults: ESR & ID folder -> ./resources/pipo/esr_id and ICO folder -> ./resources/pipo/ico.
regenerate/update existing documents checkbox replaced by Generation mode radio buttons: Generate and Update existing docs.
generation_manifest.json records generation_mode and generation_engine_mode separately.

risks_and_open_points: SAP PIPO Scenario Lab static analysis currently uses the existing CPI-oriented analyzer; the UI paths are prepared for ESR/ID and ICO evidence, while deeper PI/PO object parsing can be expanded in a later package.
